author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I don't understand why there are AI haters working in my company.

Fully embracing AI is the only logical choice in my company.

1. If AI works out great + you embrace AI -> win-win
2. If AI works out great + you hate AI -> you proved yourself is a idiot, you get fired
3. If AI is a flop + you embrace AI -> the company goes bankrupt, you lose your job
2. If AI is a flop + you hate AI -> you win the argument, but the company still goes bankrupt, you still lose your job.

comments.text:
How does "hating AI" manifest itself? do they avoid using it altogether? put obstacles for adopting AI flows? push back on AI code? or just complain, but use it anyway?

some of these responses are acceptable and reasonable, others less.
